_doc: Pre-registered review windows, kill rules, and triggers for the bot fleet.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS: two pre-registrations rotted silently in May 2026 —
the FF ARB 3rd-loss trigger (fired 2026-05-14, evaluated 26 days late) and
the CascadeFader 30-day dry-run gate (expired 2026-06-08 unevaluated) —
because they lived only in commit messages and session memory.
Every entry with status 'open' is surfaced in the daily health report
(strategy_health_report.py, PRE-REGISTRATIONS section) with an OVERDUE
marker once review_by passes. Closing an entry requires a human decision
recorded in 'resolution'. New pre-registrations MUST be added here, not
(only) in commit messages or memory.
'rules' is free text for humans. 'triggers' is the machine-checkable subset
the daily report actually evaluates: {id, metric, basis, op, threshold,
action}. Only metric 'max_drawdown_pct' is auto-evaluated today; basis is
'full_run', 'since_registered', or 'both' (breaches on the worse reading —
the conservative default when the rule's wording does not pin a denominator).
Anything expressible as a trigger SHOULD be one: on 2026-07-29 a drawdown
trigger fired and went unseen for two days because it lived only in 'rules'.
Never edit a rule in place. Changing what a pre-registration commits to
requires an entry in 'amendments' recording the reason — that is the whole
point of pre-registering. Disagreeing with a past rule is legitimate;
disagreeing with it silently is not.

rules: Rollback gate v2 if account MaxDD > 3.60% (1.5x backtest 2.40%)
Kill/demote if PF < 0.7 over 30+ closed trades since 2026-05-19
If <10 closed trades by review_by, the PF rule is NOT evaluable: review must instead compare gate-open time vs backtest expectation and decide extend/simplify, not auto-pass

triggers.action: Rollback gate v2 (registry text) — SUPERSEDED by amendment 2026-07-31, do not execute without operator sign-off
Demote to regime-halt-only (commit 34ec07b text) — SUPERSEDED by amendment 2026-07-31, do not execute without operator sign-off
Kill (commit 34ec07b text) — breaches on the full-run reading only; see amendment 2026-07-31

amendments.reason: Trigger fired 2026-07-29 04:19 UTC (LTC stop-loss close) and was not noticed for two days: the daily health report evaluated this entry only by closed-trade count and review date, so it printed 'rules not yet evaluable' — true of the PF rule, silent on the standing drawdown trigger. Fixed same day (_evaluate_dd_triggers in strategy_health_report.py); the 'triggers' block above is what it now reads.
amendments.conflict_found: Two texts disagree on BOTH threshold and action. Commit 34ec07b (2026-05-19, the actual pre-declaration): 'Demote to regime-halt-only if live MaxDD > 3.84% (1.5x backtest). Kill if DD > 8% or 5+ consecutive losses or PF < 0.7 over 30+ trades.' This registry entry (added 2026-06-09): 'Rollback gate v2 if account MaxDD > 3.60%.' The registry silently changed the number AND the action, in opposite directions — 'demote to regime-halt-only' keeps the restrictive filter (bot trades less), 'rollback gate v2' removes it (bot trades more). 3.84% is also arithmetically odd: the commit says '1.5x backtest' but 1.5 x 2.40 = 3.60, so 3.84 (=1.6x) looks like the original slip and 3.60 like a correction that overreached into the action clause. RESOLUTION: both texts are recorded as separate triggers above; neither is discarded. All three thresholds are breached.
amendments.measurement: Closed-equity MaxDD, freqtrade /profit basis. Full-run 8.60% (peak $86.46 on 2026-05-10 -> trough $79.03 on 2026-07-29; abs $7.43). Gate-v2-era only (peak re-baselined at 2026-05-19 equity $82.60) 4.32%, same trough date. Starting capital $80.65; bot-owned equity $78.91 at audit. NOTE: the '$200 live' figure in older session notes is wrong — the API reports ~$80.
amendments.decision: THREE pre-committed actions are in scope and NONE was executed. (a) 'Rollback gate v2' at 3.60% (registry) — breached, not executed. (b) 'Demote to regime-halt-only' at 3.84% (34ec07b) — breached, not executed. (c) 'KILL if DD > 8%' (34ec07b) — breached on the full-run reading (8.60%), NOT breached on the gate-v2-era reading (4.32%); not executed. Instead FundingFadeV1 was PAUSED: no new entries, open positions still fully managed (exits, ROI, stoploss and timeouts all run in PAUSED state — verified in freqtrade 2026.3 source, exit_positions() is unconditional in FreqtradeBot.process() and only entry is gated on state == RUNNING). The pause was also made durable in FundingFadeV1.live.json (initial_state running -> paused), because PAUSED is in-memory only and any restart, redeploy or VPS reboot would otherwise have silently resumed live trading.
amendments.kill_arm_override: STATED PLAINLY BECAUSE IT WOULD BE EASY TO BURY: pausing is a WEAKER action than the kill this pre-registration commits to. The kill arm fired and was overridden, not satisfied. It is an open override requiring operator sign-off, and it is live NOW — it is not deferred to 2026-08-17 and must not be treated as resolved by the pause. Two things make the override defensible rather than an evasion, and neither makes it automatic: (1) the kill arm's denominator is genuinely ambiguous in the same way the demote arm's is — it fires at 8.60% full-run but not at 4.32% gate-v2-era, and the full-run figure includes a drawdown whose peak (2026-05-10) predates the pre-registration by nine days, so the clause is being read against a window it was not written for; (2) with the bot paused and the position book down to one trade running to its own stoploss, the practical gap between pause and kill is capital allocation, not risk taken. If the operator wants the pre-commitment honoured literally, the action is to kill: stop the container and withdraw the allocation. That decision is his, and declining to make it is itself a decision that should be recorded here. The other two kill sub-clauses did NOT fire: max consecutive losses within the gate-v2 era is 3, not 5 (the full-run streak of 7 spans the May window that predates the declaration), and the PF arm needs 30+ closed trades against 6 actual.
amendments.rationale: This covers the two gate arms only; the kill arm is dealt with separately in kill_arm_override. Both gate actions LOOSEN the gate. That made sense when written: the rule is a falsification clause — gate v2 promised MaxDD 2.40%, so exceeding 1.5x means the filter did not deliver and you stop paying its cost in trade scarcity. But it was written 2026-05-19, BEFORE the OOS retest of 2026-07-13 established that the problem is not gate tightness: the gate was open 23.4% of the OOS window (backtest era 33.3%) and those 310 gate-open hours produced ONE funding signal against a claimed 1.67/wk. The signal decayed, not the gate. Executing either action today would put real money on a LOOSER version of a strategy with live gate-v2-era PF 0.078 (1W/5L, every loss a full -5% stop) and no demonstrated OOS edge. Corroboration that this is structural and not a small-N artifact: hl-carry-shadow-2026-07 has recorded ZERO episodes in 18 days because max trailing-24h funding across 40 coins is 10.95%/yr against a 40%/yr entry — the same funding-yield compression, on a different venue, measured by a different instrument.
amendments.statistical_honesty: N=6 closed trades since registration cannot establish that the edge is dead; the confidence interval is very wide, and the 2026-07-12 ADA loss was a known funding-freshness fault since fixed. The honest characterization is 'severe adverse live evidence and payoff realization inconsistent with the backtest, too few independent trades for a reliable edge estimate'. The pause is justified by the drawdown trigger and the OOS signal-scarcity finding, NOT by a claim that N=6 proves anything.
amendments.open_for_operator: TWO open items, different clocks. (1) OPEN NOW, not deferrable: sign off on or reject the kill-arm override described in kill_arm_override. The pause does not settle it — 'the bot is paused so nothing fires' is true of the two gate-loosening actions and FALSE of the kill. (2) Deferrable to 2026-08-17: which text is authoritative for the demote/rollback arms (34ec07b vs registry). That one genuinely can wait, because both candidate actions loosen a gate on a paused bot and neither can fire while it stays paused.
amendments.provenance: The pause was first applied at 2026-07-31 03:29:46 UTC by an unintended state-changing API call during this audit (a POST issued while probing endpoint availability), not by a deliberate decision. It was reported to the operator immediately with a revert command offered; the operator reviewed the finding and confirmed the pause as the intended action in the same session. Recorded because a governance file must not launder how its own state came about.

preregistrations.notes: Original window said '90d or 75 trades, whichever first' — at the gate-v2 backtest rate (1.67 trades/wk) 75 trades takes ~10 months, so the trade arm was vacuous. Live rate since redeploy is ZERO trades in 21d (BTC below SMA50/200 — mostly the pre-existing v1 base gate). Audited 2026-06-09. PAUSED 2026-07-31 — see amendments.
preregistrations.resolution: Closed by explicit operator override after the 2026-08-23 strategy-by-strategy review. The operator rejected treating the old gate as a permanent retirement rule, authorized a bounded live evolution epoch, and accepted ongoing maintenance instead of requiring a perfect historical proof. This does not retroactively validate gate-v2 or erase its adverse evidence. FundingFadeV1 starts a new live measurement epoch with updated logic, corrected custom_exit activation, exchange-resident stop protection, and portfolio-level observation under micro-live-fleet-v2-2026-08-23.

rules: At >=20 closed trades: continue dry-run if PF >= 1.0 AND WR >= 60% (deployed-docstring backtest: PF 1.62, WR 77.8%); else kill
If <10 closed trades by review_by: frequency anomaly (P ~3.9% under backtest cadence 4.37 trades/month over the 113-day window) — investigate signal-rate mismatch before extending
preregistrations.notes: Replaces the expired v1 gate ('>=5 trades in 30d', ended 2026-06-08 with 2 trades). v1 gate was mis-specified: only ~44% pass probability even if the backtest were perfect. Plumbing verified 2026-06-09: exactly 2 qualifying cascade candles occurred market-wide since deploy (both ZEC 2026-06-05) and the bot captured 2/2 with correct next-bar entries. See docs/cascade_gate_evaluation_2026-06-09.md.
preregistrations.resolution: Bot RETIRED 2026-07-13 by operator decision after cascade-fill-stress-2026-07 verdict (backtest case unreliable: PF 0.98 @0.5% slippage, 0.93 adversarial). Dry record at retirement: 2 closed, 1W/1L, -$3.29. Strategy/config/DB retained, revivable.

Trigger (3rd ARB stop-loss) fired 2026-05-14, evaluated 2026-06-09 (26 days late — the {duration} webhook bug had blinded the purpose-built pair-drift detector; fixed in 17acebc). Evaluation: qualifier 'while other pairs continue winning' NOT met — the 3rd ARB SL fell inside the fleet-wide 5-SL streak (TAO/BCH/SUI also stopped), so the loss is regime-wide, not ARB-idiosyncratic. No pair blacklist, per feedback_pairlist_strategy (never blacklist coins reactively). The original 'informed shorts' diagnosis was also a misread: post-extreme funding normalizing to Binance's +0.01% baseline clamp is the mechanical modal outcome, not evidence of informed flow. ARB stays in the whitelist; macro gate v2 is the regime defense.

rules: Trade-level calibration on deployed-actual configs BEFORE any fidelity fix (baseline capture)
OOS window = 2026-05-19 onward (data cutoff proven; zero selection influence)
No kill/scale decision on OOS PF alone at N<10 trades; calibration is primary metric
FF runs use modeled funding AVAILABILITY (4h-drift diagnostic + hourly-fix intended), never omniscient history
Keltner and Cascade each tested in BOTH validated-intended and deployed-actual variants
Report must include leave-one-pair-out (FF ex-ZEC), correlated-loss clustering, rolling-window stability
Zero-deployable-edge is a pre-registered acceptable outcome
followups: cascade-fill-model-stress-test before trusting any Cascade backtest number

F2 FF freshness guard: DONE 2026-07-31. Per-pair funding now fails closed at _STALE_FUNDING_HOURS (12h) in _align_to_dataframe, matching the macro gate; previously it only warned while forward-filling frozen funding into live bars indefinitely. The 'shadow-log first' stage was COLLAPSED: it existed to avoid changing entry behaviour mid-measurement on a running bot, and FF is paused (see ff-gate-v2-review amendment), so there is no live measurement to disturb. The guard logs every blocked bar, which preserves the shadow stage's visibility. Threshold is a pipeline-death detector and deliberately sits above the ~9.2h healthy ceiling — it does NOT catch the 10h-stale 2026-07-11 ADA trade, which the hourly :10 refresh prevents at the source. Staleness is measured per bar against the funding event that bar resolved to, not against the feather's last event, so a feed that died and later recovered fails closed across the gap instead of being waved through by a file that merely ends fresh. Tests: tests/test_ff_per_pair_funding_staleness.py (4 cases, verified RED first and re-verified against a tail-only variant). NOTE: FundingFadeV1.py md5 changed ac4e0d1e403b3451e678545e5fe3c2b4 -> 976c91642d722cff56f18ca0eaa0d446. The provenance block above is NOT updated: it records what was measured at registration and must stay historical. New FF measurement epoch = container recreate 2026-07-31 (bot restarted PAUSED, so the epoch is a code epoch, not a trading one — no forward trades accrue until the 2026-08-17 decision).
2026-08-17 review: FF gate-open-time fallback binds (1 signal / 310 gate-open hours vs 1.67/wk claimed)

preregistrations.trigger: dry entry chased +4.8% in 10min vs assumed next-bar-open fill (C4 anomaly, oos_retest_2026-07)
preregistrations.design: 1m path-aware replay of lab config (TP3%/SL-8%/48h timeout, 13 pairs, 2023-01->2026-07): uniform entry-slippage ladder {0.25,0.5,1,2,4}% AND adversarial variant (fill at next-1m HIGH; skip trade if next-1m high > signal close +5% = unfilled-cancel model). Fee 0.075%/side. Reconciliation run at 0% slippage must approximate lab metrics (PF~1.6) or the replayer is broken.
preregistrations.verdict_rule: PF < 1.2 at 0.5% uniform slippage OR at adversarial variant -> Cascade backtest case declared UNRELIABLE; recommend demote at next review
preregistrations.notes: Diagnostic/kill study; codex-approved as properly adversarial.
preregistrations.resolution: VERDICT: BACKTEST CASE UNRELIABLE (frozen rule met). PF 1.423 base -> 1.168 @0.25% slip -> 0.984 @0.5% -> 0.931 adversarial (10-min chase model). Monotone steep degradation; even 25bps entry slippage erases most of the edge. Replayer validated (regime shape matches lab; hand-trace verified; N gap vs lab attributed to data vintage + max-3 cap dropping ~47% of clustered signals). RECOMMENDATION: demote/retire CascadeFaderV1 dry bot at next review — its validated backtest case does not survive realistic entry fills. Artifacts: VPS research/cascade_fill_stress_2026-07/, script sha256 82af7720...

preregistrations.design: Shadow monitor on VPS (stdlib python, systemd user unit): minute-level executable BBO+top-of-book size both legs (HL l2Book + metaAndAssetCtxs; Binance spot bookTicker), hourly settled-funding fetch; paper tracker runs the FROZEN study config with: conservative maker-fill (HL short entry posted at best ask, deemed filled only when a later best BID >= posted level i.e. price traded through), Binance spot leg taker-at-ask, funding accrues only from next settlement after entry, max-3 concurrency with FROZEN ranking (highest trailing-24h funding at signal), executable-BBO basis (never mark).
authorizes_dry_run_only_if_ALL: trajectory yield >= 12%/yr on avg-deployed denominator (provisioned-peak yield reported alongside, always both)
realized executable basis drift consistent with study assumption (no systematic adverse gap)
conservative maker-fill rate high enough that realistic_default fee scenario holds (else re-evaluate at taker)
minimum evidence: >=5 closed paper episodes OR >=300 active position-hours by review, else shadow CONTINUES (inconclusive, not fail)
preregistrations.notes: Codex-amended (8 points, thread 019f598a). Pilot notional $1000x3 = mechanism validation, not P&L; scaling is a separate operator decision. Depth capture included so scale claims are testable later.

preregistrations.context: Operator reports dry record ~+20% P&L with high WR. Historical verdict (2026-05-28/06-06): channel unprofitable at REAL prices, edge dies at fill, do-not-fund. Dry-run grants limit fills at touch = optimistic. This audit re-prices the forward dry record under executable-fill rules.
preregistrations.method: Per dry fill (entries, TP-ladder partials): fetch Binance futures 1m klines for the window; STRICT scenario = limit fill counts at posted price only if 1m price strictly trades through (long entry L: low < L; short/TP sells: high > TP); TOUCH scenario = touch counts (current dry behavior, upper bound). SL/market exits re-priced taker with 0.05% adverse slippage. Recompute P&L/WR/DD per scenario over the full dry period.
frozen_verdict_rule: STRICT re-priced P&L >= +10% over the dry period AND WR >= 55% -> forward record contradicts historical validation -> open a separate preregistered tuning study (still dry; funding remains a distinct later decision)
STRICT re-priced P&L <= 0 -> dry-run fill optimism confirmed forward; do-not-fund RECONFIRMED; no tuning study
0 < STRICT P&L < +10% -> inconclusive; continue measuring, no tuning, revisit at next review
preregistrations.notes: Rule committed BEFORE the fill decomposition is computed. Insiders bot audited with same method, reported informationally (no frozen rule — smaller record).
preregistrations.resolution: VERDICT: NO PROMOTION / NO TUNING AUTHORIZED / CONTINUE MEASUREMENT UNDER RULE GAP. Fills FAITHFUL (0 phantom/touch-only in 88; all 46 TP fills tick-verified trade-through) — but faithful to trade-through mechanics only, not proof of live copyability (queue/latency untested). STRICT totals: +21.10% headline = banked +3.15% (closed −55.55 + booked partials +61.85) + FLOATING +17.95% on 9 leveraged runners; stop-at-risk −24.2%; closed WR 6.2%. Rule gap: success branch conjunctive (P&L>=10 AND WR>=55) did not fire, no branch covered high-floating/terrible-WR — recorded as prereg design defect. COPY-FIDELITY DEFECT: observer classified channel signal-update ('#2154 KITE close at first target') as chat -> ignored -> −$9.42 loss where channel exited in profit. KITE = sensitivity example only, NOT credited back.
prospective_rule_patch: Promotion metrics use BANKED realized P&L only; floating rider P&L reported separately, always with stop-at-risk
WR criteria apply to closed trades / completed campaigns, never mark-to-market runners
Open-risk-at-stop must stay below a fixed threshold for any promotion discussion
followups: FIX observer classifier: add signal-update kind (SIGNAL ID header + adjust/close instructions) -> receiver action; then REPROCESS full historical corpus with the new class before concluding net benefit (may also cut runners early)
Headline metric discipline: banked + floating + stop-at-risk, every report
Judgment when the 9 riders resolve or at 2026-08-17 review

Sharpe 0.785 > HODL 0.721 (pass) and 6/10 years positive (pass), BUT maxDD 89.6% vs required <49% (rode the 2021->2022 top-to-bottom; 84d filter lags turns) and 2024->now subperiod -21.7% vs HODL +41% (chop). preregistrations.hypothesis: Binance listing announcements move the announced token within minutes; a retail bot reacting at t+60s (our TG/announcement extraction infra) captures part of the move on venues where the token already trades (HL perp or Binance spot)
preregistrations.method: Collect 12-24mo of Binance listing/Will-List announcements (announcement CMS API); for each announced token tradable at announcement time (HL perp preferred, else Binance spot), measure net return paths: entry t+60s taker, exits at three FIXED horizons {+30min, +4h, +24h}; fees HL taker 4.5bps or Binance spot 7.5bps per side; report full distribution, both sample halves, per-venue
pass_criteria: median net > 0 at the t+60s -> +4h horizon across >= 20 qualifying events
positive median in BOTH sample halves
effect not concentrated: top-decile events < 60% of total
preregistrations.kill: criteria fail -> lane closed; passing authorizes a reaction-bot design study (execution latency measurement) only
preregistrations.notes: Measurement of a documented effect at fixed horizons — not a sweep. Announcement TIMESTAMP fidelity is critical: use CMS publish time; flag any event where listing trade-open predates announcement.
preregistrations.resolution: FAIL all 3 criteria at +4h (n=51 leak-excluded events, 24mo): median −2.10%, halves −3.43%/−1.22%, top-decile 73% concentration. Long-reaction lane CLOSED. HL venue inconclusive-by-data (1m retention ~3-5 days). Measured set = futures-listing announcements for already-spot-listed tokens; buying them is systematically NEGATIVE (−7.01% median at +24h, 27.5% positive).
preregistrations.forward_hypothesis_recorded: INVERTED effect: shorting futures-listing announcements (literature-consistent — derivative listing enables shorts, overpricing corrects). MUST NOT be validated on this sample (discovered here). If pursued: new prereg, FORWARD events only, venue = HL perp where available (Binance futures CVM-blocked). Execution note: our TG/announcement infra can react in seconds; effect persists 24h so latency is not critical.

preregistrations.design: SAME frozen config as hl-carry-study-2026-07 (40%/yr entry, 10%/yr exit, max 3, T1 topology, realistic-default fees) applied to (a) maximum available HL funding history (back to HL launch, not just 12mo) and (b) an EXTENDED universe: next ~20 most-liquid HL perps with Binance spot twins beyond the 20 majors. Purpose: more episodes -> tighter yield estimate NOW instead of waiting for forward episodes. Same pass criteria as phase 1; results reported per-universe-tier (majors vs mid-caps) separately.
preregistrations.notes: Extension study, not a new config — no parameter changes. Mid-cap tier carries higher funding but worse hedge liquidity; report spread/impact caveats explicitly.
preregistrations.resolution: PASS 6/6 BOTH TIERS over 3.17yr (2023-05->2026-07): MAJORS 104 episodes, +$995.85, capital yield 17.50%/yr, no-pair-max DOGE 28.7%; MIDCAP (top-20 HL perps w/ Binance spot, dayNtlVlm-ranked) 90 episodes, +$1365.45, 26.55%/yr, JTO 24.9%. Robust to return-basis accounting (both still 6/6). Episode rate ~33/yr/tier. CAVEATS: majors 2024 carried ~77% of net (2026 partial weak: 5 ep +$4.84 majors / 10 ep +$35 midcap — current regime is thin, exactly what the shadow measures); pre-2024-04 basis via 1d-candle approximation; midcap spread flags ZRO/TRB/ASTER/APT/ETHFI (11.6-26.2bps full spread vs 7.5bps assumed — hedge cost understated up to ~3.5bps/fill if taken); 1h-clean window still <10 episodes; T2 still structurally empty. CONSEQUENCE: yield estimate upgraded from 26-episode knife-edge to 194-episode 6/6; execution realism remains gated by hl-carry-shadow-2026-07 (unchanged authorization chain). Shadow universe extended to include the midcap tier same day.

preregistrations.hypothesis: SHORT the announced token on HL at t+60s after a Binance futures-listing announcement; exit at +4h and +24h (both reported). Inverse of the FAILED long study; effect observed retrospectively (median -7%/24h, n=51) but MUST be validated on FORWARD events only.
preregistrations.design: Passive monitor on VPS polls Binance CMS catalog-48 every 60s; on futures-listing announcement for a token with a live HL perp: record announcement ts, HL bid/ask at t+60s (executable short entry), and price path snapshots to +24h. PAPER only. Frozen exits +4h/+24h, HL taker fees 4.5bps/side.
pass_criteria: >=8 forward events with HL perp available
median net short return > 0 at +4h or +24h (declare which BEFORE unblinding: +24h is primary per retrospective persistence)
preregistrations.notes: Retrospective sample is the HYPOTHESIS SOURCE and is quarantined from validation. Passing authorizes a dry-run reaction bot design only. MONITOR DEPLOYED 2026-07-13 (systemd listing-monitor, bootstrap-safe, resumable). Return formula codex-verified. Unblind note: forward BBO-based numbers are execution-realistic and SYSTEMATICALLY MORE CONSERVATIVE than the retrospective 1m-close numbers (bid/ask crossing + spread + fees vs optimistic candle closes) — retrospective is optimistic reference only.

operating_rules: Treat each strategy as a maintainable live experiment, not as a proven immutable edge.
Keep per-bot status, P&L, equity, drawdown, exposure, trades, stop state, venue, and lineage visible in the dashboard.
Do not infer promotion solely from win rate, one profitable trade, or legacy backtests; compare live expectancy, drawdown, fill quality, and concentration.
A bot may continue through ordinary losses while its execution and risk controls remain healthy; investigation and iteration are preferred to automatic retirement from small samples.
Pause a bot on missing or stale required data, broken native-stop placement, database epoch contamination, repeated execution faults, or an unexplained loss beyond its configured stop model.
review_outputs: Per-bot realized and unrealized P&L, expectancy, drawdown, trade count, and fill or stop incidents
Consolidated portfolio equity, venue allocation, pair and strategy concentration, correlated exposure, and capital at risk
Maintenance decision for each bot: continue, tune with a new visible epoch, reduce allocation, or pause for a concrete operational fault
